theorem lemma_5_2_3_c {α Q : ℝ} {a k : ℤ} {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hcop : IsCoprime a (q : ℤ))
    (hα : |2 * α - a / q - k| ≤ 1 / (q * Q)) {ϱ ρ : ℝ} (hϱ : 0 ≤ ϱ) (hϱ1 : ϱ ≤ 1) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ)
    (hϱρ : ϱ * ρ < 1) (hqρ : (q : ℝ) ≤ ρ * Q) {W' W : ℝ} (hW' : 0 ≤ W') {A₀ A₁ : ℝ}
    (hA : A₁ - A₀ ≤ 2 * ϱ * q) :
    oddSqSum α W' W A₀ A₁ ≤ (W - W' + q / (1 - ϱ * ρ)) * logSqSum W' W :=

note: Outside the main-theorem cone. Erratum: As printed (5.52) bounds the sum over all m and is false: with W=400, W'=200 (32 primes), q=401, Q=10^7, rho=q/Q, varrho=1 the all-m sum is 1.334 times the right side (also with 2alpha-a/q = 1/(2qQ)), while the odd-m sum is 0.667 of it (checked by `scripts/checks/eq_5_52.py`).
